Name: Ace's Expanded Farms
Author: acerbicon
Description:
[center][/center][center][b]Ace's Expanded Farms[/b][/center][center][font=Arial][size=2]Brand new, fully functional farms. The new farms come with anything from mining[/size]
[size=2]areas and extra farming space to new ponds and waterfalls. There’s something[/size]
[size=2]for every taste. Plus, after a trip to the pet store, your pets now have a more[/size]
[size=2]comfortable living area.[/size]

[size=2]Choose the farms [/size][b]you [/b][size=2]want, for every farm type, mix and match to make
your farm fit you.[/size][color=#ff7700][size=2]

[b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b][/size][/color][size=2][color=#ff7700][b] [/b][/color]
[url=http://www.smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿[color=#e69138][b]
[/b][/color][/size][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1140/?]
[/url][/size][/b]
[b][color=#ff7700]HOW TO INSTALL:[/color][/b]
1[size=2]. Download "Ace's Expanded Farms" from the files menu and extract the zip file the "Mods" folder.

2. Run the game to generate a config file inside the "[CP] Ace Farms Expanded" folder.

3. Open the config file and replace the word "Vanilla" by the farm type(s) of your choice with whichever
version you wish to use. For example: if you want to use Cherryblossonhh's farm, change the following
"[b]Farm Style Foraging": "Vanilla" [/b]to "[b]Farm Style Foraging": "Cherryblossonhh"[/b].
[/size]
[color=#ff7700][size=2][b]EXTRA NOTES:[/b]
[/size][/color][size=2]-Are you on an old save and having trouble with bushes being in the way? Download and
use this mod to reset them: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2364?tab=files][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Entoarox Framework[/url]﻿'s "world_bushreset" command in the
[/size][/font][color=#ffffff]SMAPI console﻿.[/color][font=Arial][size=2][b]
[/b]
- Be ABSOLUTELY SURE to keep a backup of your save games. [b]ALWAYS make backups.[/b]

[b]- For Robin to build on new farm areas, you must scroll to it, either right or down. See the video below.
[/b]
- If using a map recolor, download the compatibility patch for your recolor and my mod.

[b]- If you would like to have a .png of my pet bed, bowls, and house go [url=https://i.imgur.com/mIVufqd.png]here[/url]. You are free to
use them for personal use or mods, but please credit me and/or give a link back here.

[/b][b]- Quarries included in these farms will work properly if you [/b][/size][b][size=2]download the "[/size][size=2]Ace's Expanded Farms FTM Beta Pack"
include found in the optional downloads and install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.[/b][/size]
[/b]
[youtube]0_XXqpT-56A[/youtube]
[/font][/center]
